items.name: Menace Objectives
items.desc: Through the disruption of our reality do we ascend to another.

items.name: Undertaker
items.desc: Imagine a species full of vibrant life and unbridled potential - now make it §Rstop§!.

items.name: Intimidation
items.desc: There is always another option. It is death.

items.name: Base Breaker
items.desc: Overwhelming firepower provides perspective - the ability to see a supposed fortress for what it is: a sitting duck.

items.name: Relentless Aggression
items.desc: An attacker who never tires breaks the enemy's spirit long before their walls.

items.name: Easily Replaced
items.desc: A higher quota is best met by increased production.

items.name: Death From Above
items.desc: Our fleets will blot out the sun. As many suns as it takes.

items.name: Misconfigured Thrusters
items.desc: If a ship cannot be reliably piloted, its movements cannot be reliably predicted.

items.name: Targeted Severing
items.desc: The making of a ship betrays its unmaking. There is little essential variance in the designs sprung from the galaxy's shipyards; we know them all.

items.name: Flyswatter
items.desc: No folly is beneath our notice, no trespass undeserving of retribution.

items.name: Harsh Priorities
items.desc: Only a scant few systems are required for the continued operation of a Menacing Cruiser under fire, and should be prioritized. Nonessential resources - sapient or otherwise - need not be protected.

items.name: Paid in Ambition
items.desc: Honor, glory, sadism - there is always a currency more easily minted.

items.name: Menacing Corvette
items.desc: To think that the wretches' fleets imagine themselves harried already...

items.name: Menacing Destroyer
items.desc: A crueler hunter for a crueler age.

items.name: Menacing Cruiser
items.desc: A crushing weight.

items.name: Eclipse & Apocalypse
items.desc: For far too long has the light shone on our enemies. No longer will they be able to look to the stars for inspiration.

items.name: Aetherophasic Engine
items.desc: The Aetherophasic Engine will rip apart the barriers that exist between this world and the Shroud.

items.name: Valor
items.desc: Valor is earned through steadfast action in defense of the galaxy. It is not given, but earned, proof that we act not in self-interest, but for the protection of all.

items.name: Noble Hearts
items.desc: To lead, we must be known, not through fear, but through hope. We will invest in outreach that uplifts, informs, and builds trust across the stars.

items.name: Inspired Orators
items.desc: A speech is only as good as its orator. We must tailor our words to reach the hearts and minds of our peers - however alien they may appear to us.

items.name: Stalwart Allies
items.desc: Federal administration is a powerful tool that can be leveraged for the benefit of all our allies.

items.name: Defiance
items.desc: Our spirit is strong, and we won't back down from a fight for fear of getting hurt.

items.name: Political Leaders
items.desc: Our influence grows, and with it, our ability to enact change in the Galactic Community. Our allies trust us, and we must strive to honor their faith.

items.name: Comrades in Arms
items.desc: We protect the galaxy, but it is good to know that others protect us too. By relying upon each other, we all become stronger.

items.name: Dutiful Fervor
items.desc: The Galaxy believes in us, and we are not about to let them down.

items.name: Champions of the Galaxy
items.desc: Symbolism has long shaped the course of empires. To dispel any lingering doubt as to our purpose, we must forge unmistakable emblems behind which the entire galaxy can rally.

items.name: Cerebellum Initiative
items.desc: Knowledge may be power, but true strength lies in its exchange. By sharing knowledge with our allies, we show that power need not divide. Used wisely, it unites us in common purpose.

items.name: Fortified Stations
items.desc: Our fleets are our main weapon, but not the only one. Enemies can be halted upon the anvil of our stations so the hammer of our armada can strike them.

items.name: Revered Martyrs
items.desc: There is no virtue in seeking death, but in accepting its possibility for a just cause, there is honor. Victory in the defense of the galaxy demands sacrifice, and those who give their lives for others must never be forgotten.

items.name: Beacon of Unity
items.desc: We have proven ourselves in the eyes of the galaxy. Citizens across countless worlds know in their heart that we will fight until the bitter end to protect them.

items.name: Highest Office
items.desc: With extraordinary power comes extraordinary responsibility. The mantle of Custodianship is a burden borne for the common good. These powers must never be wielded for ambition, but to draw forth the galaxy's highest ideals.

items.name: Unshakeable Resolve
items.desc: In the face of certain annihilation, we do not stand because we are stronger. We stand because we must.

items.name: By Any Means Necessary
items.desc: There are rules of war we have broken, and with full knowledge of the cost. When the current crisis is over, we will be judged. Until then, we do what we must to ensure a galaxy remains to judge us.

items.name: Harmonized Strategy
items.desc: Defense is always veiled in secrecy, but in the situation that is ours, the galaxy must band together to devise the best way to fend off its mortal enemies.

items.name: No Secrets
items.desc: The selfish secrecy that pushes us to occult our technological progress cannot be tolerated anymore. The stronger our allies, the stronger we are.

items.name: Defenders of the Galaxy
items.desc: We will fight for every star. We will fight for every world. We will fight for every life. We will fight for every inch of our home!

items.name: Conviction
items.desc: Doubt has no place in our grand design.

items.name: Propagation
items.desc: Let others recognize the path ahead, then walk alongside us.

items.name: Persuasion
items.desc: Diplomacy opens doors that force never could.

items.name: Ethical Authority
items.desc: Our moral principles grant legitimacy to our rule.

items.name: Cultural Envoys
items.desc: Our emissaries carry the spirit of our people into the stars.

items.name: Galactic Awareness
items.desc: Knowledge of the wider galaxy guides our decisions.

items.name: Manifest Destiny
items.desc: Expansion is not only our ambition, it is our destiny.

items.name: Golden Age
items.desc: We stand at the height of prosperity and achievement.

items.name: Preparation
items.desc: Vigilance and discipline keep us prepared for all possible futures.

items.name: Proselytization
items.desc: We seek to share our truth with all who will listen.

items.name: Codification
items.desc: Order is preserved through clear and enduring law.

items.name: Negotiation
items.desc: We achieve through dialogue what others attempt through war.

items.name: Dominion
items.desc: Our ethical authority extends wherever our banner flies.

items.name: Utopian Ideology
items.desc: A united galaxy will guarantee dignity and opportunity for all.

items.name: Unification
items.desc: Divided peoples become stronger under a common purpose.

items.name: Advanced Logic
items.desc: Advanced Logic represents our understanding of the laws that govern reality and our power to influence them.

items.name: Perfect Arcologies
items.desc: Fallen Empires may have forgotten how to replicate their advanced technology, but our minds will uncover the bygone secrets of their golden age.

items.name: Non-Baryonic Energy
items.desc: Learning how to harness the energy of antibaryonic particles is the next step in the evolution of ultra-compact power generation.

items.name: Wetware
items.desc: Colossal in scale, the Synaptic Lathe is a reservoir computer. The processing power of our population's networked minds is used to compute and store data. The benefits are obvious, but some misguided species may view the transmutation of individuals into computing chips as morally questionable.

items.name: Conundrumical Escorts
items.desc: A starship of modest size that optimizes our knowledge of spacetime to enact dimensional transcendentalism, making the inside bigger than its outward shape suggests. Advanced firepower capabilities come at a reduced logistical cost compared to traditional ship designs.

items.name: Advanced Harvesting
items.desc: The resource generation capabilities of Fallen Empires have long baffled us. Not anymore.

items.name: Antibaryonic Advances
items.desc: Our growing understanding of dark matter and its applications will open new avenues of technological progress.

items.name: Gravitational Tools
items.desc: Gravity and spacetime shape the universe. Starting with gravity, we will master tools to power our ascension.\n

items.name: Puzzling Cruisers
items.desc: Another optimized spacecraft, this time of larger dimensions, will make current Battleships look like toys.

items.name: Complex Infrastructures
items.desc: Now that we have begun to unravel the veil of mystery surrounding Fallen Empires, we must keep continue to pull the thread. In time, the secrets of their technology will come undone.

items.name: Exotic Antibaryons
items.desc: Using dark matter in defensive technology and encryption will enable us to create nullifying fields and robust communication channels.

items.name: Eternal Expansion
items.desc: Precise and incredibly minute alterations in gravity allow us to inject commands into the code of reality. Extreme caution is imperative as we learn the applications of this new and incredible tool.\n

items.name: Unsurmisable Flagships
items.desc: These formidable ships are closer to mobile fortresses than anything else, and only the most brutal assaults have a chance to damage them.

items.name: Golden Age
items.desc: The insights of Fallen Empires into dimensional manipulation are astonishing. With every discovery, even their most arcane technology begins to seem simplistic.

items.name: Armor and Armaments
items.desc: Our latest technological advancements should enable us to fashion deadlier weapons and more formidable armor for our ships.

items.name: Rulebreaker
items.desc: Recent experiments confirm that our edits to reality are only temporary. More significant alterations will be necessary to anchor these changes.

items.name: Memory and Creation
items.desc: The secrets of Fallen Empires, at last uncovered, will usher in a new age for our people.

items.name: Nanoswarms
items.desc: With every shift in perspective, new opportunities present themselves. Change on the smallest scale can have massive consequences.

items.name: Void Voyager
items.desc: Large-scale travel to different universes is a daunting task. We must engineer a spacecraft that can not only pierce the fabric of spacetime but also survive the journey.\n\n§RFallen Empires will try to stop us!§!

items.name: Feral Insight
items.desc: Examining Behemoth behavior will aid our ultimate goal of transcendence. We will shed the biological restrictions that govern planet-born life.

items.name: Harder Chitin
items.desc: Enduring the harshness of space requires a thick exterior. External fortitude will ensure survival even in the bleakest of conditions.

items.name: Accelerated Field Trials
items.desc: Lab experiments are a good starting point but real progress will require practical, high-risk testing in the field.

items.name: Supersized Crops
items.desc: Sating the ravenous appetite of a Behemoth is an uphill battle. Producing genetically modified food on a huge scale is a start.

items.name: Cyclopean Hatcheries
items.desc: A colossal egg demands nothing less than a titanic hatching facility. This orbital hatchery must be positioned at a deliberate distance from the star to accommodate the vast proportions needed to cradle a Behemoth.

items.name: Better Glandular Stimulation
items.desc: With purpose built probes we are artificially stimulating the endocrine glands of the Behemoth to produce growth hormones for accelerated development.

items.name: Transversal Enquiries
items.desc: At the intersection of natural selection and bio-engineering, an incomparable force is born.

items.name: Nutrient Overload
items.desc: Sating the ravenous appetite of a Behemoth may well prove impossible. Producing genetically modified food on a massive scale is only the start.

items.name: Gargantuan Brood
items.desc: A litter of Behemoths spans star systems. Our galactic neighbors will respect the autonomy of our spawn, or they will become food.

items.name: Faster Growth Cycles
items.desc: Expediting the development of giant space fauna is crucial to our ultimate goal. We will ensure our infrastructure grows in parallel.

items.name: Bio-Engineering Mastery
items.desc: Through rigorous trial and error we have developed our scientific prowess. Now we position ourselves as the galaxy's most prominent bio-engineers.

items.name: Deep Thought Shaping
items.desc: Our collective intellect is stirring, longing for something bigger and better. Our ambition knows no bounds.

items.name: Unbridled Growth
items.desc: The beast is untethered. The creature that was once a mere hatchling is fast becoming a savage, unrelenting force of nature.

items.name: Stronger Organisms
items.desc: Fueled by ravenous hunger and unyielding rage, the behemoths are reaching a chaotic level of power. Their biological weapon is primed, prepared to wreak havoc on foes and bystanders alike.

items.name: Behemoth Mutations
items.desc: We will rearrange the genetic material of the behemoths as they continue to grow, encouraging the most beneficial physiological traits.

items.name: Apex Specimen Deployment
items.desc: The pinnacle of genetic perfection will not be confined to our existing borders. It must be shared with the galaxy.

items.name: Mind Meld
items.desc: Our mind to the Behemoth, the Behemoth's mind to ours. Its rage becomes our own. We are willingly consumed, and as the beast gorges itself on our collective consciousness, we feel its fury. It becomes us, and we become beast.

items.name: Primal Roar
items.desc: It courses through us, searing, tearing, burning. A rage, a primal roar. The galaxy will burn in the flames of our fury.

items.name: Ever Hungry
items.desc: We are in agony, the constant need to feed becoming our sole motivation for existing. There is a pit within us that can never be filled, no matter how much we consume. We require nothing short of a galaxy-sized feast to quell this pain.

items.name: Ravenous Progeny
items.desc: Our spawn will gorge on the carcass of the galaxy. Their hunger knows no end. Through the infinity of time, they shall feast.

items.name: Crystallized Entropy
items.desc: §YCrystallized Entropy§! mark a breakthrough in controlled energy destabilization. With this volatile resource at our command, we can reshape the galactic order itself.

items.name: Entropy Harnessing
items.desc: Integrating §YCrystallized Entropy§! synthesis into our industry allows for more efficient use of this volatile resource, aligning our technical focus with strategic goals.

items.name: Galactic Crucible
items.desc: This proposed Crucible would serve as a central engine for harnessing stellar entropy. With the ability to crystallize and transport it, the Crucible could become a beacon of our fiery power, spreading it across the stars.

items.name: Concentrated Entropy
items.desc: Conduits are vital to expanding our power at this stage. Increasing Crucible output will accelerate our march toward a brighter, burning future.

items.name: Radiant Ambitions
items.desc: Being the spark that ignites the galaxy leaves no time for second-guessing or bureaucracy. We can't afford to lose time remodelling countless systems. To achieve our goals, we must dramatically increase our construction capacity.

items.name: Forced Ignition
items.desc: Sometimes, pushing harder isn't enough. We need to take our technology to the next level and exploit its full potential. It's time to minimize safeguards and maximize output.

items.name: Ember Cruiser
items.desc: Equipped with cutting-edge technology, these vessels convert volatile heat flux into directed annihilation, reducing our enemies to charred cinders.

items.name: Engulfing Flames
items.desc: The utopia we envision leaves no room for opposition to our goals. Any who try to stop us will quickly learn that resistance will be met with a rain of fire upon their homeworlds.

items.name: Coronal Venting
items.desc: Our Conduits currently dissipate massive heat to remain stable. By venting that heat into surrounding space, we could turn the Conduits into devastating weapons against our enemies.

items.name: Heliofusion Reactors
items.desc: Harnessing §YCrystallized Entropy§! in military tech unlocks propulsion systems of unparalleled power. Our ships will blaze across the stars like never before.

items.name: Artificial Solar Flare
items.desc: There was a period when parts of the galaxy lay beyond our grasp. That illusion is ending. Soon, swarms of our Conduits will saturate the stars, bringing calibrated devastation to all who oppose us.

items.name: Blazing Armada
items.desc: As the galaxy consolidates against us, mobilization becomes imperative. Every citizen must now contribute to sustaining the energy front, fanning the flames of our ascendancy.

items.name: Ember Battleship
items.desc: With gun barrels as hot as the firestorm that is about to engulf the galaxy, these large ships will make up the bulk of our defensive forces around the Crucible.

items.name: Critical Mass
items.desc: Increasing the entropic activity in a star's outer shell causes the star to pour forth a swell of radiation. This is causing entire systems to heat up more rapidly.

items.name: Infused Ammunition
items.desc: A refinement in munitions design: standard ordnance is now augmented with micro-scale entropy cores, releasing destabilized thermal surges upon impact. The result is markedly enhanced destruction.
